arxiv-2004-08899.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Mohamed Mahmoud Chems-Eddin. Let p ≡ − q ≡ 5 ( mod 8 ) p\equiv-q\equiv 5\pmod{8} be two prime integers. In this paper, we investigate the unit groups of the fields L 1 = ℚ ⁡ ( 2 , p , q , − 1 ) L_{1}=\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2},\sqrt{p},\sqrt{q},\sqrt{-1}) and L 1 + = ℚ ⁡ ( 2 , p , q ) L_{1}^{+}=\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2},\sqrt{p},\sqrt{q}) .

arxiv-2101-10524.title: El Volumen Louder Por Favor: Code-switching in Task-oriented Semantic Parsing
arxiv-2101-10524.creator: Arash Einolghozati, Abhinav Arora, Lorena Sainz-Maza Lecanda
arxiv-2101-10524.description: Abstract Being able to parse code-switched (CS) utterances, such as Spanish+English or Hindi+English, is essential to democratize task-oriented semantic parsing systems for certain locales. In this work, we focus on Spanglish (Spanish+English) and release a dataset, CSTOP, containing 5800 CS utterances alongside their semantic parses.

arxiv-2105-08518.title: Decoupling multivariate functions using a non-parametric Filtered CPD approach footnoteinfo This work was supported by the Flemish fund for scientific research FWO under license number G0068.18N.
arxiv-2105-08518.creator: Jan Decuyper, Koen Tiels, Siep Weiland, Johan Schoukens
arxiv-2105-08518.description: Abstract Black-box model structures are dominated by large multivariate functions. Usually a generic basis function expansion is used, e.g. a polynomial basis, and the parameters of the function are tuned given the data. This is a pragmatic and often necessary step considering the black-box nature of the problem.

arxiv-2110-03320.title: Automated Testing of AI Models
arxiv-2110-03320.creator: Swagatam Haldar, Deepak Vijaykeerthy, Diptikalyan Saha
arxiv-2110-03320.description: Abstract . The last decade has seen tremendous progress in AI technology and applications. With such widespread adoption, ensuring the reliability of the AI models is crucial. In past, we took the first step of creating a testing framework called AITEST for metamorphic properties such as fairness, robustness properties for tabular, time-series, and text classification models.

arxiv-2202-02013.title: A Benchmark Corpus for the Detection of Automatically Generated Text in Academic Publications
arxiv-2202-02013.description: Abstract Automatic text generation based on neural language models has achieved performance levels that make the generated text almost indistinguishable from those written by humans. Despite the value that text generation can have in various applications, it can also be employed for malicious tasks. The diffusion of such practices represent a threat to the quality of academic publishing.

arxiv-2208-02446.title: Evaluating Plant Disease Detection Mobile Applications: Quality and Limitations
arxiv-2208-02446.creator: Ayesha Siddiqua, Muhammad Ashad Kabir, Tanzina Ferdous, Israt Bintea Ali, Leslie A. Weston
arxiv-2208-02446.description: Abstract In this technologically advanced era, with the proliferation of artificial intelligence, many mobile apps are available for plant disease detection, diagnosis and treatment, each with a variety of features. These apps need to be categorized and reviewed following a proper framework that ensures their quality.

arxiv-2303-03784.title: Tunability of Andreev levels in a spin-active Ising Superconductor/Half Metal Josephson junction
arxiv-2303-03784.creator: Saumen Acharjee, Arindam Boruah, Nimisha Dutta and Reeta Devi
arxiv-2303-03784.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Saumen Acharjee, Arindam Boruah, Nimisha Dutta and Reeta Devi. We study the Andreev levels, supercurrent and tunnelling conductance in a clean Ising superconductor (ISC)/half metal (HM)/Ising superconductor (ISC) Josephson junction with spin-active interfaces using Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations. We theoretically demonstrate the effect of spin mixing, spin flipping processes and spin-orbit coupling (SOC) of the ISC on Andreev Bound States (ABS) spectra, current phase relation (CPR) and tunnelling conductance in transparent and opaque barrier limit.

arxiv-2305-12502.title: Watermarking Diffusion Model
arxiv-2305-12502.creator: Yugeng Liu Zheng Li Michael Backes Yun Shen Yang Zhang
arxiv-2305-12502.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yugeng Liu Zheng Li Michael Backes Yun Shen Yang Zhang. The availability and accessibility of diffusion models (DMs) have significantly increased in recent years, making them a popular tool for analyzing and predicting the spread of information, behaviors, or phenomena through a population. Particularly, text-to-image diffusion models (e.g., DALL·E 2 and Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) have gained significant attention in recent years for their ability to generate high-quality images and perform various image synthesis tasks.

arxiv-2306-06232.title: Probing self-supervised speech models for phonetic and phonemic information: a case study in aspiration
arxiv-2306-06232.creator: Kinan Martin, Jon Gauthier, Canaan Breiss, Roger Levy
arxiv-2306-06232.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kinan Martin, Jon Gauthier, Canaan Breiss, Roger Levy. Textless self-supervised speech models have grown in capabilities in recent years, but the nature of the linguistic information they encode has not yet been thoroughly examined. We evaluate the extent to which these models’ learned representations align with basic representational distinctions made by humans, focusing on a set of phonetic (low-level) and phonemic (more abstract) contrasts instantiated in word-initial stops.

arxiv-2306-10293.title: A New Perspective for Shuttlecock Hitting Event Detection
arxiv-2306-10293.creator: Yu-Hsi Chen
arxiv-2306-10293.description: Abstract This article introduces a novel approach to shuttlecock hitting event detection. Instead of depending on generic methods, we capture the hitting action of players by reasoning over a sequence of images. To learn the features of hitting events in a video clip, we specifically utilize a deep learning model known as SwingNet.

arxiv-2308-10699.title: Cost-Efficient Online Decision Making: A Combinatorial Multi-Armed Bandit Approach
arxiv-2308-10699.creator: Arman Rahbar armanr@chalmers.seChalmers University of Technology and University of Gothenburg, Niklas Åkerblom niklas.akerblom@volvocars.comVolvo Car CorporationChalmers University of Technology and University of Gothenburg Morteza Haghir Chehreghani morteza.chehreghani@chalmers.seChalmers Universit
arxiv-2308-10699.description: Abstract Online decision making plays a crucial role in numerous real-world applications. In many scenarios, the decision is made based on performing a sequence of tests on the incoming data points. However, performing all tests can be expensive and is not always possible.

arxiv-2402-01854.title: Efficient implementation of discrete-time quantum walks on quantum computers
arxiv-2402-01854.creator: Luca Razzoli *, Gabriele Cenedese, Maria Bondani, Giuliano Benenti
arxiv-2402-01854.description: Abstract Quantum walks have proven to be a universal model for quantum computation and to provide speed-up in certain quantum algorithms. The discrete-time quantum walk (DTQW) model, among others, is one of the most suitable candidates for circuit implementation, due to its discrete nature.

arxiv-2509-05632.title: Batalin-Fradkin-Vilkovisky Quantization of FLPR model
arxiv-2509-05632.creator: Ansha S. Nair and Saurabh Gupta
arxiv-2509-05632.description: Abstract Abstract: We quantize the Friedberg-Lee-Pang-Ren (FLPR) model within the framework of Batalin-Fradkin-Vilkovisky (BFV) formalism. We construct the nilpotent Becchi-Rouet-Stora-Tyutin (BRST) charges using constraints and the fermionic gauge-fixing function by means of admissible gauge conditions. We also derive the BRST invariant effective action and corresponding symmetries of the model in both polar and Cartesian coordinates.

arxiv-2511-02568.title: Kneading the Lorenz Attractor
arxiv-2511-02568.creator: Łukasz Cholewa ∗ , Eran Igra ∗∗
arxiv-2511-02568.description: Abstract . A Lorenz map f : [ 0 , 1 ] → [ 0 , 1 ] f:[0,1]\to[0,1] is a piecewise continuous map, modeled after an idealized version of the Lorenz attractor. In this paper we settle the following question - how much of the dynamics of the Lorenz attractor can be modeled by such one-dimensional model?

pmc-10582573.title: Behavioral and neurophysiological indices of the racial bias modulation after virtual embodiment in other-race body
pmc-10582573.creator: Maria Pyasik, Alice Mado Proverbio, Lorenzo Pia
pmc-10582573.description: SummaryRacial bias—nonconscious behavioral inclinations against people of other ethnic groups—heavily contributes to inequality and discrimination. Immersive virtual reality (IVR) can reduce implicit racial bias through the feeling of owning (embodying) a virtual body of a different “race”; however, it has been demonstrated only behaviorally for the implicit attitudes.

pmc-10702401.title: Reactions to Misoprostol: A Case Report
pmc-10702401.creator: Arsalan Salari, Aseme Pourrajabi, Samaneh Karami, Zahra Hamidi Madani
pmc-10702401.description: Background:Most of abortions occur before the 13th week of pregnancy. Nowadays, non-surgical approaches for evacuation of uterine have been replaced with surgical ones due to the reduction in bleeding, fewer complications, ease of management, and cost-effectiveness. Misoprostol is a prostaglandin E1 analog that is used for labor induction. It is known as a safe drug with very few side effects.

pmc-11399291.title: Proposal for a framework for environmental zoning of areas near gold mines based on the distribution of potentially toxic elements, pollution indices, and bioindicators: a case study in Antioquia, Colombia
pmc-11399291.creator: Julián E López, Juan F Marín, Juan F Saldarriaga
pmc-11399291.description: Gold mining, even under strict environmental regulations, inevitably causes environmental impacts and liabilities. To address this, the study proposes a framework for environmental zoning around gold mines based on the distribution of potentially toxic elements (PTEs), pollution indices, and bioindicators.

pmc-11417502.title: Melting and Rapid Solidification of Lunar Regolith Particles Returned by Chang’E-5 Mission
pmc-11417502.creator: Xian Zhang, Yiwei Liu, Shaofan Zhao, Jian Song, Wei Yao, Weihua Wang, Zhigang Zou, Mengfei Yang
pmc-11417502.description: Melting and solidification of lunar regolith are pivotal for comprehending the evolutionary dynamics of lunar volcanism, geology, and impact history. Additionally, insights gained from these processes can contribute to the advancement of in situ resource utilization technologies, for instance additive manufacturing and resource extraction systems.

pmc-11427978.title: Immediate-use steam sterilization and the effect on surgical site infection risk in an acute care facility
pmc-11427978.creator: Victoria D Crall, Casey L Lewis, Avisha Risnear, Jason Miller, Joanne Sherer, Ashley M Ayres, Graham M Snyder
pmc-11427978.description: Immediate-use steam sterilization (IUSS) shortens the time of sterilization but may increase the risk of surgical site infection (SSI). Among 23,919 procedures with 416 (1.7%) procedures resulting in SSI, IUSS was associated with a 1.52 (95% CI, 1.10–2.11) times higher risk of SSI. IUSS should be minimized.

pmc-11732353.title: High expression of RBM15 is associated with better prognosis in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-11732353.creator: Yingda Liu, Yu Pu, Xunjie Kuang, Yuzhu Jiang, Jiali Liu, Nan Dai, Mengxia Li, Kunkun Li, Mingfang Xu
pmc-11732353.description: BackgroundEsophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is a highly prevalent and malignant form of esophageal tumor associated with high rates of patient mortality for which there remains a persistent lack of effective targets for therapeutic interventional efforts. This study was developed with the goal of exploring the expression and functional role of RBM15 in ESCC.

pmc-12485546.title: The Destination, Not the Journey: Optimal Vessel Preparation to Prevent Recurrent In-Stent Restenosis After Brachytherapy
pmc-12485546.creator: Samantha Espinosa, Musa Sharkawi, Brian Bergmark
pmc-12485546.description: and 20% annual TLR rates in the plain old balloon angioplasty (POBA) and bare metal stent eras, respectively.1 However, in-stent restenosis (ISR) remains the Achilles heel of DES therapy, with approximately 10% of PCIs in the United States each year performed for ISR.2 In-stent restenosis is also independently associated with worse clinical outcomes including mortality.

pmc-12969086.title: Nanocomposite hydrogel acupoint therapy for sustained pregabalin delivery and long-term neuropathic pain relief
pmc-12969086.creator: Xiping Duan, Manjing Li, Zifan Liu, Wenyu Chen, Tianlong Chan, Ruoxi Zhang, Jia Zhou, Yichun Xu, Ke Wang
pmc-12969086.description: Neuropathic pain (NP) presents significant management challenges due to the limited efficacy and adverse effects associated with current therapeutic options. In this study, we present an innovative nanocomposite hydrogel designed for acupoint administration (PG@PLGA-gels) that synergistically combines nanomedicine with traditional acupuncture principles.

pmc-13181117.title: An aerial color image anomaly dataset for search missions in complex forested terrain
pmc-13181117.creator: Rakesh John Amala Arokia Nathan, Matthias Gessner, Nurullah Özkan, Marius Bock, Mohamed Youssef, Maximilian Mews, Björn Piltz, Ralf Berger, Oliver Bimber
pmc-13181117.description: After a family murder in rural Germany, authorities failed to locate the suspect in a vast forest despite a massive search. To aid the search, a research aircraft captured high-resolution aerial imagery. Due to dense vegetation obscuring small clues, automated analysis was ineffective, prompting a crowd-sourcing initiative.

pmc-13231289.title: Housing Attainment With the Psychiatric Assistance for Transitional Homelessness in Shelters Program
pmc-13231289.creator: Sheng-Yun Cheng, Chih-Hao Tseng, Hsiao-Yun Hu, Chih-Chiang Chiu, Yu-Ru Lin, Yu-Chi Pan, Ming-Chin Yang, Pesus Chou, Po-Yu Chen, Ming-Chyi Huang
pmc-13231289.description: Key PointsQuestionWhat demographic and clinical factors are associated with successful housing attainment for individuals experiencing homelessness with mental illness under an on-site psychiatric program?FindingsIn this 5-year cohort study of 208 participants, 46.6% achieved housing attainment; older age was associated with greater success, whereas substance or alcohol use disorders were associated with lower likelihood of success.

pmc-13496349.creator: Jinjiao Wang, Jenny Y. Shen, Fang Yu, Sandra F. Simmons, Amanda S. Mixon, Kobi Nathan, Marian S. Moskow, Judith D. Brasch, Sally A. Norton, Kathi L. Heffner, Yun Jiang, Sudha Seshadri, Neela Patel, Lixin Song, Joseph A. Zorek, Christine Lam, Thomas V. Caprio

pmc-13555615.title: Metagenomic Insights Into Microbial Diversity of Tea Rhizosphere of the Kangra Valley
pmc-13555615.creator: Rishu Thakur, Hena Dhar, Shashi Kiran, Arvind Gulati
pmc-13555615.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study provides the first metagenomic assessment of microbial diversity from the tea rhizosphere of the Kangra valley. Tea rhizosphere soil samples were collected from 4 locations (Dharamshala, Baijnath, Palampur, and Joginder Nagar) of the Kangra valley. DNA extracts of rhizosphere samples were analysed for bacterial and Archaeal diversity using amplicon sequencing (V3‐V4) region of the 16S rRNA gene and Fungal diversity using ITS1 and ITS2 regions.
